stem.en: For an experiment, an echo must reach you at least 0.2 s after the sound is made. Sound travels at 343 m/s. What is the smallest distance to the reflecting wall?

explanation.en: In 0.2 s, sound travels 343 × 0.2 = 68.6 m. That is out to the wall and back, so the wall is 68.6 ÷ 2 = 34.3 m away.

hints.en: The sound goes out to the wall and back again.
Find the distance travelled in 0.2 s, then halve it.
